question: Which restaurant was ranked No. 1 on The World's 50 Best Restaurants list for 2026?
answer: Asador Etxebarri, in the Basque region of Spain, was ranked No. 1 on The 50 Best Restaurants 2026 list, announced at a ceremony in Lima, Peru, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 [3][5]. The restaurant is in Atxondo, Spain [2][3], and the NYT notes it had been No. 2 for the previous two years [5]. Bon Appétit and CNN describe its flame-grilling as its signature [1][2]. Gaggan in Bangkok came second, and Alchemist in Copenhagen third [2][3].
